C07 and C02 share only limited proclamation phrasing and a purpose-limitation formula in unrelated immigration-quota machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas during the ten years since the Seventeenth Decennial Census was taken great changes have occurred in the growth, location, and characteristics of our people and in their housing and activities...","parent_excerpt":"Whereas during the ten years intervening since the Sixteenth Census... changes in the growth, location, and characteristics of our people and in their housing and industries...","explanation":"The child closely adapts the parent’s third recital, updating the intervening events and census subjects."},{"child_excerpt":"it is the duty of every person over eighteen years of age to answer all questions in the census schedules applying to him and the family to which he belongs... and that any person refusing to do so is subject to penalty as provided by law.","parent_excerpt":"it is the duty of every person over eighteen years of age to answer all questions in the census schedules applying to him and the family to which he belongs... and that any person refusing to do so is subject to penalty as provided by law.","explanation":"The central operative declaration is reproduced nearly verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"The sole purpose of the Census is to secure general statistical information... No person can be harmed in any way by furnishing the information required... every employee of the Census Bureau is prohibited, under heavy penalty, from disclosing any information...","parent_excerpt":"The sole purpose of the Census is to secure general statistical information... No person can be harmed in any way by furnishing the information required... every employee of the Census Bureau is prohibited, under heavy penalty, from disclosing any information...","explanation":"The detailed purpose, non-use, confidentiality, and employee-penalty assurances follow the same sequence and language."},{"child_excerpt":"Life and liberty in a free country entail a variety of cooperative actions for the common good. The prompt, complete, and accurate answering of all official inquiries made by Census officials should be regarded as one of the requirements of good citizenship.","parent_excerpt":"Life and liberty in a free democracy entail a variety of cooperative actions for the common good.
